This change is correct but might have performance implications if the path is long or complex. In `extractSuffixMaps`, the handling of lists and maps could be more straightforward. The current implementation uses recursion extensively, which might lead to stack overflow issues with deep nested structures. Additionally, the logic for building keys with dots is not entirely clear and could be simplified. The while loop in `extractSuffixMaps` can be simplified by using a for-loop with an index increment, which would make the code easier to read and understand. The comment about handling subobjects with "." chars in the key name is helpful but could be moved to a method-level comment or documentation for better clarity. The `insertValue` method's behavior when encountering ambiguous paths is correct, but the error message could be more descriptive. It might be useful to include the conflicting paths in the exception message to help with debugging.

review_comment:
We got a two-for-one with this bug fix 😁 

Since the semantic text field type adds sub-objects to the mapping upon first document ingestion, it cannot be in an object field with subobjects disabled. Before this fix, doing so resulted in Very Bad Things™, such as the [document parser handling inference sub-fields as runtime fields and triggering assertion failures](https://github.com/Mikep86/elasticsearch/blob/516aa119453d97ec7ac58292e8a91642a5d75893/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/DocumentParser.java#L1039-L1039).
